response.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN eligible e ON e.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_tat_diff FROM per_patient;

assumptions.assumption: Per-patient TAT minus TAT2 is averaged over rows where both TAT and TAT2 are non-null (the difference is null otherwise and ignored). Patients whose per-patient average is null are excluded from that outer average.
Exact match '-' is case- and whitespace-sensitive, as the request says 'exactly'.
